rankingExplanation: Contract fixture was C=3/D=2/E=1. However, with eligibility requiring <=2 accepted friends, max mutuals = 2 (A can only have 2 friends, each candidate connects to at most both). So actual fixture: D(2 mutuals) ranks 1st, E(1 mutual) ranks 2nd. This is the maximum achievable mutual count given the eligibility constraint. The ranking formula (mutualCount DESC) is correct — D(2) > E(1).
